tooltips.attendanceManagementManagers: The only users allowed to see and open the attendance overview, send reminders, and download registers.
tooltips.attendanceManagementEditablePastMonths: Number of complete previous calendar months employees may still change. The default of 1 permits the current and immediately previous month; older months are locked.
tooltips.attendanceManagementAllowIncompleteExpor: When enabled, attendance managers can download XLSX and PDF files even when employees have missing entries or schedules. Missing information is left blank. Disabled by default.
tooltips.attendanceManagementScheduleEditor: Set the normal entry and exit time for each employee. Changes apply to every attendance month.
